details: eml_parser serves as a python module for parsing eml files and returning various information found in the e-mail as well as computed information. In 3.0.3 and earlier, eml_parser.routing.parserouting() in eml_parser/routing.py builds a regular expression with multiple greedy capture groups and appends the npdate date literal extracted from a normalized copy of an attacker-controlled Received header, then searches that expression against the original unnormalized line. A formatting difference can make the trailing literal impossible to match, causing exhaustive backtracking across the greedy groups at each start position. The unsliced Received-header path is invoked by decode_email, decode_email_bytes, and parse_email, so one small unauthenticated message can pin a parser worker and create sustained queue backlog. This issue is fixed in version 3.0.4.
